name: Skeleton
description: Animated bones with a notched sword and no will of its own.
tactics: Marches straight at the nearest player. Never retreats.

name: Restless Ghost
description: A pale shape drifting through the walls of the house it died in.

powers.name: Chilling Wail
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Passes through walls to reach its target.

tactics: Appears, wails, vanishes into a wall. Weapons without magic or silver roll with disadvantage.

name: Brain Drinker
description: A purple-skinned thing with a squid for a face and a taste for thoughts.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Stunned players have disadvantage next turn.

powers.name: Skull Tap
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Only works on a stunned or grabbed target.

tactics: Blasts the group, then drinks the dazed. Keeps thralls to take hits for it.

name: Eye Tyrant
description: A floating, toothy orb with one huge eye, a dozen eye-stalks and an unshakable belief that it is better than you.

powers.name: Eye Rays
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. The GM picks a different effect per ray (burn, freeze, sleep, push).

powers.name: Null Gaze
powers.text: No damage. Its central eye switches off all magic and powers in its line of sight until it looks away.

tactics: Hovers out of reach and treats the party as insects. Keep it from facing the caster.

name: Giggle Sprite
description: A thumb-sized glittering fairy that ties shoelaces together and steals hats.

powers.name: Giggle Dust
powers.text: No damage. A target that is dusted giggles uncontrollably and has disadvantage on its next roll.

tactics: Never fights fair. Flees laughing the moment it is caught.

name: Rainbow Trickster
description: A little green-coated gent who guards a pot of gold at the end of every rainbow and will trade it for a riddle.

powers.name: Lucky Dodge
powers.text: No damage. Turns the first hit against it into a miss, then it vanishes in a puff of glitter.

tactics: Would rather bargain than fight. Fights with riddles and bad puns first.

name: Mushroom Mayor
description: A round little mushroom wearing a sash who throws a parade for anyone who visits the village.

powers.name: Healing Spores
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to itself or an ally. Players inhaling the spores also heal 2d6 once per rest.

tactics: Peaceful. Defends the village by throwing a party that is hard to leave.

name: Moonhorn
description: A white steed with a silver horn, hooves that leave daisies and a cure for any sniffle.

powers.name: Healing Horn
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any target in reach.

tactics: Does not like fighting. Only attacks creatures it considers wicked, which it can always tell.

name: Bone Sorcerer
description: A robed corpse with a crown of fused finger bones and a voice like cold wind through a graveyard.

powers.name: Soul Drain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Heals the sorcerer for the same amount.

powers.name: Grave Call
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Raises a 0.25 skeleton for every fallen creature.

tactics: Sends skeletons first. Revives if its phylactery (a hidden item) is not destroyed.

name: Blood Noble
description: A pale lord in a velvet cloak who has not seen a sunrise for six hundred years.

powers.name: Blood Drain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Heals the noble for the same amount.

powers.name: Mist Form
powers.text: No damage. Turns to mist, ignoring the next attack and slipping through cracks.

tactics: Appears charming, then bites. Weak to sunlight, running water and silver stakes.

name: Grave Knight
description: A rust-black knight with burning blue eyes, sworn to a lord who died a thousand years ago.
tactics: Challenges the strongest player to single combat. Never retreats, never surrenders.

name: Hellspawn
description: A horned, smoldering fiend with bat wings and a ledger of souls.

powers.name: Hellfire
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Sets terrain alight.

powers.name: Soul Bargain
powers.text: No damage. Offers a player a deal; if accepted, it gets one favor from them later.

tactics: Offers a deal before the fight, and again when losing. Cannot be killed on its home plane.

name: Void Tentacle
description: A shifting pile of writhing limbs, eyes and teeth that does not obey geometry and whispers numbers no one should know.
skillNote: Players who look directly at it have disadvantage on their next roll.

powers.name: Madness Gaze
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Damaged players are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Writhing Grab
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Grabbed targets must win a Physique challenge to break free.

tactics: Not a fight to win but a nightmare to survive. Flees if you have a way to banish it.

name: Swamp Hag
description: A hunched, moss-draped woman with an iron cauldron, a bone-hut on chicken legs and a very patient grin.

powers.name: Wicked Curse
powers.text: No damage. A target is cursed: disadvantage on one skill until the hag is slain or a favor is paid.

tactics: Offers a drink or a bargain. Eats children and the foolish, in that order.

name: Warp Fiend
description: A red-skinned, horned thing that bleeds out of the warp wherever skulls are piled and prayers are screamed.

powers.name: Warp Rend
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Tears at the target's soul.

tactics: Cannot be harmed by non-magical weapons. Vanishes if the summoner's ritual is broken.

name: Haunted Sheriff
description: A grey, tattered lawman in a tin star who still patrols a ghost town and still arrests the living.

powers.name: Final Warrant
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Served with cold, ghostly authority.

tactics: Reads the party their rights, then the charges. Releases anyone who pays the old fine.

name: Briny Kin
description: A bulging-eyed, gill-necked person-fish who smells of low tide and speaks in wet, burbling prayers.
tactics: Rises from the sea in numbers. Retreats to the water to recover.

name: Ghoul
description: A hunched, rubbery thing that lives in graveyards, eats the dead and sometimes the not-quite-dead.
tactics: Comes in a pack. Paralyzes one victim with a scratch (fail a Physique challenge or lose a turn).

name: Faceless Gaunt
description: A black, rubbery, horned flyer with no face at all that tickles.

powers.name: Carry Off
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Grabs a target and flies off with it, to be dropped from a great height.

tactics: Strikes from above in silence. Carries off the weakest.

name: Pale Fungoid
description: A winged, pink, crab-like fungus from the edge of the solar system with a bad habit of removing brains and keeping them in jars.

powers.name: Brain Cylinder
powers.text: No damage. A player at 0 health has their brain removed and kept alive in a jar, until it is returned.

tactics: Collects specimens. Retreats if the party is too strong.

name: Star Wing
description: A bat-winged, goat-skulled steed of the void that carries cultists across the sky.

powers.name: Spirit Away
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Grabs a target and flies into the sky.

tactics: Rides cultists and carries off prey. Can be summoned by a ritual or a flute.

name: Sunken Dreamer
description: A mountain-tall, winged, tentacle-faced titan who sleeps beneath the waves and dreams of an ending.
skillNote: Players that look at it are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

powers.name: Dream Call
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players in the radius have disadvantage on their next roll.

powers.name: Wake the Tide
powers.text: No damage. Summons a flood that drags players into the water, forcing a Physique challenge to avoid drowning.

tactics: Not a fight but a cosmic event. Sinks back into the sea when the stars shift.

name: Upload Ghost
description: The scanned, half-corrupted mind of a dead hacker, living in the building's wiring and very unhappy about it.

powers.name: Haunt the Wire
powers.text: No damage. Shuts down or takes over one device, door or implant within sight until it is destroyed.

tactics: Appears on screens. Begs for help, then locks the doors.

name: Gallows Tree
description: A twisted dead cottonwood on a hill with a rope that sways in no wind and a ring of bones at its roots.

powers.name: Noose Snare
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A rope drops over the target and hauls them up.

tactics: Does not move. Works best at dusk and on lone travelers.

name: Crossroads Fiend
description: A well-dressed stranger at the crossroads at midnight who will teach you any song for the price of your soul.

powers.name: Devil's Bargain
powers.text: No damage. Offers a power or item for a favor; if accepted, the player gets advantage once per rest and owes a soul later.

powers.name: Hellhound Call
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Summons a hellhound for one attack.

tactics: Offers a deal before a fight and during it. Vanishes at dawn.

name: Dream Eater
description: A slender, pale thing with too many limbs and a voice that sounds like your own desire.

powers.name: Siren Whisper
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A tempting whisper that hurts the mind.

tactics: Dances between targets. Offers the weakest player their heart's desire.

name: Warp Lord
description: A towering, horned, winged tyrant of the warp with a burning axe and a throne made of skulls.

powers.name: Warp Storm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. A wave of raw chaos.

powers.name: Soul Reaping
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to itself for each player at 0 health or fallen this round.

tactics: Appears when a ritual succeeds. Banished if the ritual's focus is destroyed.

name: Grave Imp
description: A foot-tall, skin-and-bone thing with a long tongue that giggles when it breaks your things.
tactics: Serves a bigger master. Steals small items and sets small fires.

name: Cheeky Poltergeist
description: A giggling, invisible prankster that rearranges furniture, throws spoons and steals socks.
tactics: Never fights seriously. Flees when someone says its name three times.

name: Hearth Spirit
description: A tiny, bearded spirit who cleans the house at night in exchange for a saucer of milk and no thank-yous.

powers.name: Tidy Up
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally who has slept in the house.

tactics: Neutral guardian of the home. Becomes spiteful if insulted or paid in clothing.

name: Riddle Sphinx
description: A lion-bodied, human-faced, eagle-winged guardian that asks one riddle at the desert crossing.
tactics: Asks a riddle. A correct answer lets players pass; a wrong answer means a fight.

name: Ferryman of Souls
description: A hooded, silent boatman who poles a skiff across a black river for a single coin.

powers.name: Final Crossing
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Only used against a creature that refuses to pay or tries to cross uninvited.

tactics: Neutral. Takes anyone who pays and has no interest in fighting. Cannot be bribed.

name: Siren
description: A beautiful, silver-scaled singer on a rock whose song pulls sailors straight to the reef.

powers.name: Lure Song
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A hypnotic song that draws the target toward the water.

tactics: Sings from a rock and waits for ships. Dives and vanishes underwater when hurt.

name: Drowned Captain
description: A barnacle-bearded captain with a tentacled face and a hand on a chest that holds the hearts of drowned sailors.

powers.name: Kraken's Call
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Tentacles lash up from the sea.

powers.name: Dead Man's Bargain
powers.text: No damage. Offers a drowning player a second chance at the cost of a year of service.

tactics: Rules a ghost ship and a crew of the drowned. Cannot leave the sea.

name: Gaslamp Specter
description: A pale, gaslight-flickering figure in a bowler hat who walks the foggy streets and never leaves a footprint.

powers.name: Lamp Snuff
powers.text: No damage. Puts out every light within sight, leaving the area in darkness.

tactics: Appears under streetlamps. Vanishes in fog when approached.

name: Glow Wraith
description: A flickering, green-white ghost that rises from a blast crater and burns everything it touches.

powers.name: Rad Burn
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is irradiated (disadvantage) until it rests.

tactics: Haunts craters and ruined reactors. Cannot leave the place it died.

name: Dust Oracle
description: A swirling, human-shaped dust devil that speaks in the voices of the dead and always tells the truth, eventually.

powers.name: Dust Vision
powers.text: No damage. Shows a player one true vision about the past or future of a place or person.

tactics: Neutral. Wants a gift or a favor in return. Scatters if disturbed too much.

name: Ghost in the Wire
description: The leftover mind of a dead hacker that now lives in the city power grid.

powers.name: Blackout
powers.text: No damage. All lights and electronics in sight go dark for a turn. Everyone has disadvantage to see or aim.

tactics: Flickers lights and locks doors to split the party, then hits whoever is standing near a socket.

name: Lamp Post Ghoul
description: A tall pale figure that stands under broken street lamps, softly humming to itself.
tactics: Only moves when nobody is looking right at it. Follows anyone who stops to hum along.

name: Pocket Sprite
description: A thumb-sized prankster that lives in pockets and steals buttons.
tactics: Swaps small items between pockets. Giggles when caught and flies away.

name: Saloon Spirit
description: A cheery ghost bartender that keeps pouring drinks for people who have long since left.

powers.name: Last Call
powers.text: No damage. All enemies have disadvantage on their next roll.

tactics: Offers free rounds to calm the room. Starts flinging glassware when anyone cheats at cards.

name: Sunken Lighthouse Keeper
description: A waterlogged keeper whose lantern burns green and never goes out.

powers.name: Green Beacon
powers.text: Area 2d6 damage to all enemies, ignores defense.

tactics: Lures ships onto the rocks with his lantern. Waits for the survivors in the shallows.

name: Rift Whisperer
description: A tall shape that leaks out of a tear in the sky and promises everyone the thing they most want.

powers.name: Whisper of Ruin
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target has disadvantage on their next roll.

tactics: Offers temptations and breaks the will of the weakest first. Fights only when cornered.

name: Neon Shrine Fox
description: A glowing fox with nine fiber-optic tails who guards a tiny shrine between two skyscrapers.
tactics: Tricks people into getting lost in the alleys. Rewards offerings of fried snacks.

name: Boiler Ghost
description: The ghost of a stoker who died in the boiler room and still shovels coal in the dark.
tactics: Slams furnace doors and sends steam through the pipes. Calms down if someone keeps the fire stoked.

name: Aether Djinn
description: A smoky spirit trapped in a brass pressure pipe who grants wishes and reads every clause too closely.

powers.name: Twisted Wish
powers.text: No damage. One enemy gets advantage on their next roll, but only if the ally who asked for it takes 1d6 damage.

tactics: Offers deals with sharp fine print. Bursts out of the pipe if the contract is broken.

name: Lantern Ghost
description: A small floating lantern flame with a faint smile that leads travelers away from danger.
tactics: Guides lost people to shelter. Flickers out if anyone is cruel to it.

name: Static Sprite
description: A crackling blue wisp that leaks out of old comm panels and shocks anyone who touches the wiring.
tactics: Hides in a console and zaps the first player to reach for a button.

name: Starlight Wisp
description: A tiny drifting lantern of starlight that leads travelers off the path for fun.
tactics: Leads one player away from the group. Pops harmlessly when hit.

name: Hangar Haunt
description: The flickering echo of a dead pilot that still runs pre-flight checks on a wrecked fighter.
tactics: Slips through bulkheads and chills a player on the way past. Fades when the ship is repaired.

name: Warp Imp
description: A grinning scrap of warp-stuff that pops out of cracks in the hull and chews on wiring.
tactics: Teleports a short hop each turn. Goes for the smallest, most valuable gadget.

name: Glitch Gremlin
description: A pixelated pest that lives in implants and makes them stutter at the worst time.
tactics: Latches onto one player's gear and gives them disadvantage on their next gadget roll.

name: Bilge Sprite
description: A slimy little spirit that lives in the bottom of the hold and loosens every knot it can find.
tactics: Cuts a rope or loosens a plank. Flees if it is spotted.

name: Cog Sprite
description: A buzzing spark of living gearwork that rides on steam vents and jams machinery for fun.
tactics: Jams one machine or lock. Giggles loudly while doing it.

name: Star Oracle
description: A robed figure of living starlight that sees every battle before it happens.

powers.name: Foretold Doom
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target must succeed on a Wits roll or lose their next turn.

tactics: Always acts first. Ignores any player who has not yet been named in its vision.

name: Void Whisperer
description: A faint voice from the dark of space that makes soldiers turn on each other.
tactics: Speaks to a single soldier at a time. Fades when the lights come on.

name: Nebula Phantom
description: A drifting shape of gas and light that wraps around ships and drains their power cells.
tactics: Slides through the hull and goes for the reactor. Hates bright light.

name: Netspace Wraith
description: A digital ghost that jumps from implant to implant, wearing the faces of the dead.
tactics: Possesses a nearby cybernetic limb. Leaves when the host is knocked out.

name: Deep Net God
description: A vast alien intelligence that wakes in the lowest layers of the net and rewrites whoever looks at it.

powers.name: Mind Rewrite
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target acts as an ally of the net until the end of next turn.

tactics: Speaks through every screen. Takes over implanted players one at a time.

name: Squall Wraith
description: A whirlwind of rain and a woman's screaming face that rides storm fronts.
tactics: Whips the sails and tosses sailors overboard. Calm seas make it vanish.

name: Aether Poltergeist
description: A spirit that haunts steam pipes and sends gouts of hot vapor through valves.
tactics: Slams valves and shakes pipes. Banished when the boiler is shut down.

name: Aether Sovereign
description: An ancient spirit of lightning and brass that rules the aether between the cogs of the world.

powers.name: Aether Storm
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Electrical devices in the zone fail.

tactics: Floats above the machinery. Drains power from every device in reach.

name: Fallout Revenant
description: A thing made of dust and radiation that wears the shape of someone who died in the blast.
tactics: Drifts toward the group slowly. Drains the life out of anything it touches.

name: Ashen Herald
description: A tall figure of smoke and ash that walks in front of the next great storm.

powers.name: Ashfall
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Everything in the zone is covered in ash, causing disadvantage.

tactics: Walks slowly. Everything it touches turns to ash.

name: Pocket Pet Ghost
description: A pixelated pet that lives inside an old handheld, hungry and wanting to be fed.

powers.name: Feed Me
powers.text: Drains one device. It will not work until the pet is fed.

tactics: Begs for attention. Eats the battery of whatever device is closest.

name: Cabin Boy Ghost
description: The ghost of a young cabin boy who tags along with new crews and gets into trouble.

powers.name: Ghostly Prank
powers.text: Unties a rope or hides a tool. One player has disadvantage on their next roll.

tactics: Pops up with warnings and pranks. Disappears if the ship changes hands.

name: Warp Seer
description: A blind psyker whose eyes are sewn shut, shouting prophecies as the warp bleeds through.
tactics: Floats above the crowd and predicts every move. Screams when it is struck.

name: Hollow Man
description: A tall thing in a trench coat with no face and no hands, known by the empty streets it leaves behind.
tactics: Appears in the corner of the eye. Takes one player quietly.

name: Devil of the Badlands
description: A smiling stranger in a black duster who wins every duel and collects the losers' souls.

powers.name: Soul Gamble
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The loser of a Wits contest is cursed until the devil is defeated.

powers.name: Hellfire Quickdraw
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain and gear.

tactics: Offers a deal first. Calls a duel at high noon.

name: Comet Sprite
description: A giggling spark of light that rides in the exhaust of starfighters and tickles the pilots.
tactics: Zips between ships and tweaks the controls. Pops if caught.

name: Warp Jester
description: A jingling clown-shaped daemon that pops out of the warp to juggle skulls and ruin the mood.
tactics: Tells a terrible joke. Whoever laughs gets disadvantage.

name: Dust Devil
description: A spinning whirl of sand with a face in the middle that sweeps across the desert at dusk.
tactics: Whips across the camp and scatters supplies. Settles when it hits water.

name: Will-o-Wire
description: A drifting ball of blue static that haunts abandoned research stations and leads the lost into the dark.
tactics: Drifts ahead of the group and tries to lure them. Fades if the power comes on.

name: Void Bride
description: A pale, veiled shape that rides the dead ships of a lost fleet and calls for her missing crew.

powers.name: Veil of the Void
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pulled out into open space.

tactics: Drifts through the wreck. Pulls a player into the void with her veil.

name: Data Succubus
description: A seductive net-spirit that wears a lover's face and feeds on whoever it hacks.

powers.name: Memory Drain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target forgets the last thing they did.

tactics: Logs in as someone the target trusts. Drains their implants dry.

name: Lantern-Keeper Ghost
description: The ghost of an old lighthouse keeper who now steers ships into reefs.
tactics: Appears on the cliff at night. Lights false beacons.

name: Spectral Leviathan-Captain
description: A ghostly captain in barnacle-covered robes who rides the back of a drowned whale-ship.

powers.name: Drowning Curse
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target's lungs fill with seawater until the curse is lifted.

tactics: Rises from the waves at midnight. Offers a bargain for a ghost's passage.

name: Tick-Tock Wraith
description: A pale shape that dwells inside the great clock-tower and whispers the hours of the dead.
tactics: Drifts from clock to clock. Stops anyone who tries to wind the tower.

name: Glowing Memory
description: A friendly shimmer of a person from before the war who just wants to share a meal.
tactics: Follows the players. Tries to share memories of a better time.

name: Fallout Banshee
description: A shrieking shape in a tattered dress who walks ahead of every dust storm.

powers.name: Death Wail
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is deafened and has disadvantage until they rest.

tactics: Screams as the storm rolls in. Fades when the dust settles.

name: Ghost Tide
description: A wave of pale, grasping hands that rises out of calm water to pull sailors under.
tactics: Rises at the stern. Pulls a sailor into the water.
